title: A/P Detail: switching location in the top right reloads the report
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The organization has open documents in these reports at two locations, {Location-A} and {Location-B}, and you are enrolled at both; {Location-A}'s name comes first in A to Z order.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 and {Location-B} is Staging Lethbridge - 4310.
  • Vendor {Vendor-A} has an overdue bill {Bill-A} at {Location-B} and others at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Vendor-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S5-34 Switcher.
  • Starting screen: A/P Detail (Reports, then "A/P Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu, with {Vendor-A} ticked, "Past due: 1-30 days" ticked, the "Amount" header clicked once, every group expanded and the page scrolled down.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open the location switcher in the top right of ShopView.
  2. Switch to {Location-B}.
  3. Click {Bill-A}'s number.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the location switcher opens.
  • Step 2: the report reloads and you stay on it, with the same filters (the same as-of date, {Vendor-A} ticked, "Past due: 1-30 days" and every location ticked) and the same rows, back in the opening order (the Amount sort is gone); every group is collapsed and the page is back at the top.
  • Step 3: it is now a link and its delivery opens (before the switch it was plain text, because it was at another location).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location), story SV-11537 (Story 7, Document links open where they can)

  • S5-E2: “Switching location in the top right of ShopView while on a report reloads it, as on every other report: the user stays on the report with the same filters and the same rows; the sort returns to the opening order (Story 1), every group collapses and the page returns to the top; which documents link, prompt or show as plain text updates (Story 7).”
  • Out of Scope: “The location switcher in the top right of ShopView. It is not changed. Switching location while on one of these reports reloads it, as on every other report: the filters and the rows stay, because the reports are organization-wide; the sort returns to the opening order, groups collapse and the page returns to the top; which documents link, prompt or show as plain text updates (Story 7).”
  • S7-E1: “The location switcher in the top right of ShopView is not changed.”
